title: Sindh Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1996

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VIII OF 1996
ACT VIII OF 1996
SINDH MINISTERS
(SALARIES, ALLOWANCES
AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act further to amend the Sindh Ministers (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 8th April, 1996]
No.PAS/Legis-B-1/96.---The Sindh Ministers
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 1st February, 1996 and assented to by
the Governor of Sindh on 28th February, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of
the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Ministers (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Insertion of new section 8-A in the Sindh Act VIII of 1975

ACT VIII OF 1996
ACT VIII OF 1996
SINDH MINISTERS
(SALARIES, ALLOWANCES
AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act further to amend the Sindh Ministers (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 8th April, 1996]
No.PAS/Legis-B-1/96.---The Sindh Ministers
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 1st February, 1996 and assented to by
the Governor of Sindh on 28th February, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of
the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Insertion of new section
8-A in the Sindh Act VIII of 1975.--In the Sindh Ministers (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act 1975:---
(i) after section 8, the
following shall be inserted:---
"8-A. Custom duties or
sales tax not leviable on certain articles.---No custom duties or sales tax
shall be levied on one car Mercedes Benz 280 SEL or equivalent for his personal
use if imported or purchase out of bond by the Chief Minister on his
appointment or during his tenure of office".
(ii) the existing section 8-A
shall be re-numbered as section 8-AA.
